SMTO-WEB-0047 — SMTO can't ask you for more research steps right now

GUID: 56ec87af-6923-5eb0-9dda-e6bd47567fa3
Slug: research-budget-unavailable
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO tried to ask your permission to do more web searches or page reads, but it can't ask yet: it still has unused steps you approved, another question is waiting for you, or it has already asked too many times.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If another question or permission request is waiting in the conversation, answer it first. SMTO can only have one permission question open at a time.
  2. Otherwise let SMTO continue; it should use the steps you already approved or finish with what it found. SMTO only asks for more once the steps you already allowed are used up.
  3. If the answer still lacks something, send a new message with a narrower question about that part. A new request starts its own research with fresh limits for the part you care about.

What success looks like

  • SMTO continues researching, or finishes with an answer that lists the sources it used.

If it still fails

  • If SMTO seems stuck waiting with no question visible, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • request_research_budget returned research_budget_unavailable: there is no research state, 32 budget requests already exist, another authority request is pending, or a previously approved extension for these budgets is still unused.

What this means

  • Budget extension is unavailable without research state, at the request-record bound, during another authority wait, or while a prior approved allowance is still unused. This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Budget extension is unavailable without research state, at the request-record bound, during another authority wait, or while a prior approved allowance is still unused.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the specific availability condition, existing authority wait and unused approved increments.

How to fix it

  • budgets.request() refuses when ensure() returns no research state, len(budget_requests) >= 32, authority_control.pending() reports an open request, or the prior approved request for the same keys still has remaining allowance. Resolve the pending authority item or consume the existing extension first; asking for an extension never grants acquisition authority by itself.
  • Use the current allowance or finish with retained evidence.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use the current allowance or finish with retained evidence.

How to verify the fix

  • Existing decisions or allowances are resolved before an eligible new request is considered.

What not to do

  • Do not assume that requesting an extension grants more acquisition authority.

Technical notes

  • This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
